window.note: At zero vig, p=0.700 prices at -233 and p=0.714286 prices at exactly -250, so the intersection of 'greater than 70 per cent' and 'between -250 and +10000' is a band only 0.0143 wide in probability space. tiers.Medium: Single-sided official evidence (hard-capped), or consensus-only, or p >= 0.62 with an in-window price.

classes.A: An official governing body published a rating, record or seed for BOTH sides.
classes.B: An official governing body published a rating for ONE side only. Hard-capped at Medium.

model_constants.label: Every number in model_constants is OUR assumption, not a sourced fact. Facts come only from official_sources.

derived.home_win_rate_basis: 33 home wins and 28 away wins across the 61 games in the official EuroLeague standings (sum of the H column and the A column).
derived.hca_formula: HCA = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(official home win rate) = 11.5 * Phi^-1(0.540984)
derived.ladder_rule: Handicap and total rungs sit on a half-point grid only, so no rung can push. Handicap rungs step 1.0 from 0.5; total rungs step 1.0 either side of the centre rounded to the nearest half point.
derived.ladder_sign_rule: A handicap line's sign follows its label: the home side gives points and is stored negative, the away side receives them and is stored positive. Home -h and away +h share the same threshold h in margin space.
derived.ladder_saturation_rule: A ladder stops before its first saturated rung. Once a probability reaches the clipping ceiling, every deeper rung is numerically identical, so emitting them would only pad the board with duplicates carrying no information.
derived.offset_rule: Offset is the cushion, in the sport's own unit, between the line and our expected margin measured in the direction of the bet: home -h gives |centre - h|, away +h gives |h + centre|. The tightest-rung rule compares these cushions.
derived.rejected_ledger_rule: Only the informative rejections are printed per fixture - the match winner when a genuine favourite is priced too short, and the nearest miss to the -250 floor. The full rejected count is kept on every row and the complete ladder stays on the markets page, so nothing is silently dropped.
derived.tightest_rung_rule: Among rungs that clear both the 70 per cent floor and the price window, the one closest to our own centre is taken. Ties break on market order Match Winner, Handicap, Match Total, then on the smaller line.
derived.totals_rule: A match total is originated ONLY where an official body published the scoring inputs. Where it did not, the total is left blank and flagged TOTAL-NOT-ORIGINATED. We never infer a total.
derived.spread_rule: A handicap ladder is originated only where we hold an official rating input (Class A or B). Where the official body published scoring data we use the true margin centre; where it published only a rating (seed, rank, top-16 status) we convert that probability into the equivalent margin centre via sigma * Phi^-1(p) so the ladder is still expressed in the sport's own unit. Class C rows carry a moneyline only and are flagged SPREAD-NOT-ORIGINATED.
derived.winner_pick_rule: The match-winner pick always follows the favourite side, not the first-listed side, so an away favourite is picked correctly.
derived.name_crosswalk_rule: For club fixtures the market labels use the official club names from the governing body's own standings, while the fixture string is kept exactly as OLBG rendered it. The crosswalk maps names only and never carries a numeric value.

F-1A-CLOCK-04 proves the basketball hub clock is US Eastern Daylight Time by an exact 6-hour offset against official CEST kick-offs, and F-1A-CLOCK-01 shows a 5-hour internal inconsistency on the greyhound hub. A user reading 'Today 14:05' has no way to know which of these it is without external cross-referencing.

findings.title: Empty hubs render the sports-menu chip as 'All Sports'
findings.detail: On a hub with no fixtures, OLBG's breadcrumb chip falls back to the literal text 'All Sports' instead of naming the sport, so the page does not identify itself.

findings.title: The high-confidence window is granularity-limited, not conviction-limited
findings.detail: The window p >= 0.70 AND price >= -250 spans only 0.0143 of probability. A handicap rung steps probability by 0.3434/sigma per half point, so whether any rung lands in the band is governed by the sport's scoring variance rather than by how strong the favourite is. At sigma 11.5 (basketball) a qualifying rung exists almost always; at sigma 2.30 (darts legs), 2.0 (snooker frames) or 1.15 (volleyball sets) it almost never does. This is why every High selection on this desk comes from basketball, while genuine 0.75-0.79 favourites in darts and snooker are rejected for landing a few American points short of -250.

findings.title: GitHub Pages reports 'built' for commits whose content is not being served
findings.detail: Between 09:11Z and 09:56Z on 2026-10-22 the Pages publication for this repository did not advance, while the API reported status 'built' for two later commits: 1a88c0d7 at 09:24:52Z (duration 216646ms) and 8540478b at 09:34:27Z (duration 28609ms). Content merged after 09:11Z is not served. /OLBG1/92af340c/index.html - a directory added by 8540478 itself - returns the repository's own 404 page, and /OLBG1/1a421e41/index.html still serves the 09:11 revision: its KPI card reads 2938 markets where main at 8540478 reads 1642, and its High-confidence lede still shows the literal '70%%' fixed by PR #98. Requesting a build is not possible: POST /repos/buffedlizard55-lab/OLBG1/pages/builds returns 403 Resource not accessible by integration. The repository payload is only 67MB, so this is not a size limit. Consequence: any session that verifies publication by reading the build status will believe its work is live when it is not. The check that works is to fetch a path that only exists in the commit you expect to be served.

evidence.blocked: POST /repos/buffedlizard55-lab/OLBG1/pages/builds -> 403 Resource not accessible by integration

findings.resolution: Resolved at 10:02Z without any action being available. The build for b56d45b5 reported built at 10:01:32Z and the probe that had returned the repository 404 at 09:47Z and 09:56Z began serving normally; /OLBG1/1a421e41/window.html then returned the current revision, which confirms the whole tree is current because a Pages deployment is one atomic artifact. Total stall 09:11Z to 10:01Z, about 50 minutes across four builds, two of which reported built without their content being served. The finding stays published because the failure mode - trusting pages.status instead of the served bytes - will recur at the next merge storm.
